text: A wise judge teaches the laws to the people, and a smart ruler gets things organized.
The people of a town and its lower officials usually follow the example set by the judges and rulers.
A stupid king destroys his nation, but a city grows if its leaders can rule well.
The Lord controls all authorities on earth, and he appoints the best rulers for each situation and time.
God alone gives the success that brings honor to those who write the laws.
When neighbors harm you, don't be angry or proud.
The Lord and all people hate pride and become angry with injustice.
A wealthy and arrogant nation that fails to show justice will soon be conquered.
Why are we humans so proud? We are only dust and ashes, and we easily lose our health and strength.[20]
A long illness mocks the skill of physicians,[21] and even a king can die without warning.
Then after our death, our bodies are eaten by wild animals and maggots and worms.
We humans start to be arrogant when our hearts turn away from the Lord our Creator.

Sins are the source of pride, and if we hold on to it, our lives will be flooded with more disgusting sins. So the Lord destroys[22] the proud by punishing them with disasters they never dreamed possible.
He removes powerful rulers, replacing them with the humble.
When God decides to give land to a humble nation, he pulls up others by the roots
and plows through their fields until nothing remains.
The Lord destroys some of them so completely, that no one remembers they ever lived.
When the Lord created humans, he did not intend for us to be proud and angry.
We deserve honor only when we fear the Lord, but we should not be honored if we break his laws.
A family should give honor to its leader, but God honors all who fear him.
He accepts them, but he rejects those who are proud and stubborn.[23]
Fearing the Lord is something to be proud of— whether you are poor, or rich and famous, a Jew, or a Gentile.
Don't look down on those who are wise but poor, and don't honor sinners.
Honor always comes to judges and people in power, but anyone who fears the Lord is even more deserving.
So if you are smart, you will understand when you see a master serving a wise servant.
Don't spend your time thinking of ways to avoid work, and don't pretend to be well off if you are short of money.
It's better to work and have more than enough than to boast and go hungry.
Students, be humble but remember to have proper self-esteem.
Who will think you are innocent if you call yourself guilty? And who will give you honor if you refuse to respect yourself?
The poor receive honor if they are educated, while the wealthy are praised because they have money.
So when the poor become rich they will be praised more, but the disgrace of the wealthy will become much worse if they lose their money.
